description: Importance dimensions a customer can weight (0..1) when expressing a requirement. Used by the LLM to encode 'I care a lot about performance, less about aesthetics' and by the ML ranker to weight compatibility features per-customer.

dimensions.name: price
dimensions.description: Sensitivity to staying within budget / finding a good deal

dimensions.name: performance
dimensions.description: Speed, DPI, refresh rate, response time, polling rate

dimensions.name: ergonomics
dimensions.description: Comfort, weight, layout, adjustability for long sessions

dimensions.name: durability
dimensions.description: Build quality, switch lifespan, warranty, materials

dimensions.name: audio_quality
dimensions.description: Driver size, frequency response, ANC, impedance (headphones)
